title: Fix static checks failing on CI upgrade PRs after flit_core bump
body:
## Why

`breeze ci upgrade` runs `upgrade_important_versions.py`, which bumps the `flit_core` pin in every provider `pyproject.toml`. Those files are generated from `dev/breeze/src/airflow_breeze/templates/pyproject_TEMPLATE.toml.jinja2`, but the script does not update the pin there. So the `update-providers-build-files` hook regenerates them back to the old pin, and static checks fail on both upgrade PRs.

## What

Add the template to `FILES_TO_UPDATE`, so the same `flit_core` bump also moves the template pin. Another option is to read the flit version from one place, like the hatchling branch of the template already does with `airflow-core/pyproject.toml`, but that changes breeze's generation code, so I kept this small to backport to v3-3-test.

related: #73519, #73629
